title: Weighted Search And Ranking
summary: Use setweight, ts_rank, and ts_rank_cd to make ranking match product and document intent.
learning_objectives: Explain the PostgreSQL full-text search concept in operational terms.
Write or critique SQL that applies the concept to the document_search corpus.
Name the evidence that would change the search design.
reflection_prompts: What evidence says this is a lexical search problem?
What operational cost does this search design add?

references.why: Cross-cutting search choices and not yet guidance.
